title: Swift 2S Turbo DNA Library Kit Protocol: Fully Automated
author: Opentrons (verified) Swift Biosciences
materials: Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Enter protocol parameters
steps.instruction: Input the desired protocol parameters into the OT‑2 software.

steps.title: Download protocol file
steps.instruction: Download the generated protocol file to your computer.

steps.title: Upload protocol to OT App
steps.instruction: Upload the downloaded protocol file into the Opentrons OT App.

steps.title: Arrange deck according to map
steps.instruction: Set up the OT‑2 deck following the provided deck map, placing all required labware and consumables in the specified slots.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Calibrate the labware, tip racks, and pipette in the OT App using calibration tips as described in the support articles.

steps.title: Start the run
steps.instruction: Press “Run” in the OT App to begin the automated library preparation.
